title: BXT-135 custom GRX2x11 owner build and ride report
notes: Owner post dated2025-10-02 describes a custom GRX2x11/CSC-wheel BXT135 build, unlike the retained GRX1x11/TANDELL complete. Reports a firmer front than their prior gravel bike, attributed to integrated handlebar, and more comfortable rear, attributed to seatpost. Different axes/components mean it does not directly refute or corroborate the Reddit frame-movement report. No numeric frame-stiffness result. Parent and worker read relevant passages.
